title: Sum of Array Elements
statement: Write a Java program to calculate the sum of all elements in an integer array.
hint: Loop through the array with a for-each loop and keep a running total.

title: Count Vowels in a String
statement: Write a Java program that counts the number of vowels in a given string.
hint: Loop through each character and check if it matches a, e, i, o, or u (case-insensitive).

title: Second Largest in an Array
statement: Find the second largest element in an array without sorting it.
hint: Track both the largest and second largest as you scan the array once.

title: Check Balanced Parentheses
statement: Write a program to check if a string of brackets is balanced, using a stack.
hint: Push opening brackets onto a stack; pop and compare when you see a closing bracket.

title: Find Missing Number
statement: An array contains n-1 distinct numbers from 1 to n. Find the missing number.
hint: Compare the expected sum of 1..n with the actual sum of the array.

title: Two Sum Problem
statement: Given an array and a target, find two numbers that add up to the target.
hint: Use a HashMap to store each number and its index while scanning once.

title: Merge Two Sorted Arrays
statement: Merge two sorted arrays into a single sorted array.
hint: Use two pointers, one for each array, and always take the smaller current element.

title: Custom Exception for Validation
statement: Design a custom exception hierarchy to validate a user's age and email together.
hint: Create one base exception and two subclasses for each validation rule.

title: Thread-Safe Counter
statement: Implement a counter that stays correct when incremented by multiple threads at once.
hint: Synchronize the increment method, or use AtomicInteger.

title: Group Words by Length using Streams
statement: Given a list of words, group them by their length using the Stream API.
hint: Use Collectors.groupingBy with String::length as the classifier.
